name: Tongkat ali (Eurycoma longifolia)
description: Root of Eurycoma longifolia, a Southeast Asian plant also called Malaysian ginseng

status.usStatus: Dietary supplement · not an approved drug

note.text: Most used standardized water extracts in Malaysia. One case report describes liver injury after use.

bullets: **In rats,** root compounds showed aphrodisiac and testosterone effects
**In young men,** testosterone and estradiol rose; LH, FSH, SHBG did not change
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

practical.routes: By mouth (standardized water extract) in trials
practical.soldAs: Dietary supplement; not FDA reviewed before sale
practical.monitored: Testosterone, cortisol, symptom and erectile function scores

regulatory.text: No approved drug; sold as dietary supplement

references: Medicina (Kaunas), Eurycoma longifolia and testosterone meta-analysis, Aug 2022
Andrologia, tongkat ali in healthy young men, May 2021
Cureus, tongkat ali liver injury case report, Mar 2024
